verses.text: <pb/><t>Ni fure ce na Sharon,</t> <t>Furen bi-rana na cikin kwari. <pb/></t>
<t>Kamar yadda furen bi-rana yake a cikin ƙayayuwa,</t> <t>Haka ƙaunatacciyata take a cikin sauran mata. <pb/></t>
<t>Kamar yadda itacen gawasa yake a cikin itatuwan jeji,</t> <t>Haka ƙaunataccena yake a cikin sauran maza.</t> <t>Da farin ciki na zauna a inuwarsa,</t> <t>Ina jin daɗin halinsa ƙwarai.</t>
<t>Ya kai ni babban ɗakin da ake liyafa,</t> <t>Ƙauna ita ce tutarsa a gare ni.</t>
<t>Ka ciyar da ni da wainar zabibi,</t> <t>Ka ba ni 'ya'yan gawasa in sha in wartsake!</t> <t>Gama na cika da sha'awarka.</t>
<t>Bari ka ta da kaina da hannun hagunka,</t> <t>Ka rungume ni da hannun damanka.</t>
<t>Ku 'yan matan Urushalima,</t> <t>Ku rantse da bareyi, da batsiyoyi,</t> <t>Ba za ku shiga tsakaninmu ba,</t> <t>Ku bar ta kurum.</t>
<t>Na ji muryar ƙaunataccena!</t> <t>Ya zo a guje daga kan tuddai,</t> <t>Ya sheƙo daga tuddai zuwa wurina.</t>
<t>Ƙaunataccena kamar barewa yake,</t> <t>Kamar sagarin kishimi.</t> <t>Ga shi can, yana tsaye a bayan katangarmu.</t> <t>Yana leƙe ta tagogi,</t> <t>Yana kallona ta cikin asabari.</t>
<t>Ƙaunataccena ya yi magana da ni. <pb/>Tashi mu tafi, ƙaunatacciyata, kyakkyawa.</t>
<t>Gama lokacin sanyi ya wuce,</t> <t>Ruwa kuma ya ɗauke.</t>
<t>Furanni suna hudowa a itatuwa ko'ina.</t> <t>Lokacin raira Waƙoƙi ya yi,</t> <t>Lokacin da kurciyoyi suke kuka ya yi.</t>
<t>'Ya'yan ɓaure sun nuna,</t> <t>Tohon inabi yana ƙanshi.</t> <t>Tashi mu tafi, ƙaunatacciyata, kyakkyawa! <pb/></t>
<t>Ya kurciyata kina zaune a kogon dutse mai tsayi.</t> <t>Bari in ga fuskarki, in kuma ji muryarki,</t> <t>Gama muryarki tana da daɗin ji,</t> <t>Fuskarki kuma tana da kyan gani. <pb/></t>
<t>Ku kama mana 'yan ƙananan diloli</t> <t>Waɗanda suke ɓata gonakin inabi,</t> <t>Gama gonakin inabinmu sun yi fure. <pb/></t>
<t>Ƙaunataccena nawa ne, ni ma tasa ce,</t> <t>Yana kiwon garkensa a cikin furannin bi-rana,</t>
<t>Har hurowar iskar safiya,</t> <t>Sa'ad da duhu ya kawu.</t> <t>Komo ya ƙaunataccena, yi kamar barewa,</t> <t>Kamar sagarin kishimi a kan duwatsu.</t>
